protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold (5 folds by speaker, 10 repeats); cross-dataset transfer; refit on all speakers
limitations: Trained on 951 sustained-vowel recordings from 284 speakers (212 with Parkinson's, 72 healthy) from two research datasets; validated only by speaker-independent cross-validation and cross-dataset transfer, not clinically. Phone and laptop microphones differ from the research recording setups. Screening research output, not a diagnosis.
